Metabolic status
Metabolic changes can include hyperglycemia as seen with several antiretrovirals (e.g., abacavir, atazanavir, dolutegravir, lamivu-
dine, saquinavir), other antimicrobials (e.g., posaconazole), and neurologic agents (e.g., aripiprazole, bupropion, escitalopram,
lamotrigine, olanzapine, quetiapine). Hypoglycemia may be expected with some drugs (e.g., insulin, glyburide) but also occur
with others as an “off-target” effect (e.g., ﬂuoroquinolones). Hypertriglyceridemia and hypercholesterolemia have been reported
during treatment with some antimicrobials (e.g., clindamycin, dolutegravir, efavirenz), and neurologic drugs (e.g., mirtazapine,
olanzapine, quetiapine).
Overall nutritional status
